hooks.command: powershell.exe -NoLogo -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command "[void][Console]::In.ReadToEnd(); if ([Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('ANTIGRAVITY_PLUS') -eq '1') { [pscustomobject]@{decision='deny';reason='Start the subagent with the Paseo create_agent tool so the user can see and control it.'} | ConvertTo-Json -Compress } else { [pscustomobject]@{decision='allow'} | ConvertTo-Json -Compress }"
